title: Picture abhi baaki hai
format: Kitty Gang filmi trailer for the theme's game night, cut short with the payoff by 12 s

experiment.hook: Ishita in the Gabbar costume and Tina in the Chandni saree face off on the Filmi Duniya home art, villain riff and sting at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip 'AAJ RAAT: FILMI HOUSIE', Ishita says 'Is Housie ki hero main hoon!'
experiment.variable: length: a reel of about 15 s before the ending (half our usual 28 to 32 s), with the reveal by 12 s, told as a filmi trailer
experiment.hypothesis: every theme reel loses people in the middle (watched 8 to 17%); a reel half as long with the payoff early lifts watched % above 25 and keeps skip under 62%, with at least 1 share

idea: Filmi trailer: Ishita (Gabbar) and Tina (Chandni) both sit on 14 of 15 at the Filmi Duniya game, the last ball pops 27, and Myra in the Basanti outfit takes Full House; Aditi closes the picture.
beats: hook: villain vs heroine, Ishita: hero main / Tina: picture abhi baaki hai / setup: dono 14/15 / reveal: 27 / turn: Myra Full House / button: Ishita: picture baaki hai? Aditi: nahi, The End
caption: {theme} Housie ki picture mein hero kaun banega? Aapka filmi naam comment karo!

lines.text: Is Housie ki hero main hoon!
lines.say: इस हाउज़ी की हीरो मैं हूँ!
